content.label: The buttons in the opening screens are not visible to advance and open the app.

title.label: Great note taker but needs in-app recording

content.label:
This is the best AI note taker I’ve used. Way better than Teams and Google Meets. Not even close. Wave actually knows what you are saying. And its summarization feature is amazing and useful.

However…

You cam only record when the app is open. I need it to record whatever audio is playing on my phone. This way I cam record Teams meetings on my phone and decode podcasts.

Please add! Otherwise I am forced to use a competitor which is a shame.

title.label: Just What I'd Been Looking For!!

content.label:
I’d been looking for a couple of years for a note taking app that does what I want. It was exciting a few months ago when Notability added transcription to their audio recording feature. But the transcriptions, while very accurate, were only made available in paragraph chunks. And there was no summary.

Then I recently spotted Wave AI Note Taker. Perfect for my needs. Business meetings, doctor appointments, sermons, etc. Thank you so much for what you've created. I know that the early days involve a lot of bug fixes, and I see that you’re updating the app very frequently. Thanks for that too.

For the first couple of days after I started using your app, I had trouble getting to sleep, because I was thinking of all the different ways I could use it. In some settings, it can be a little intimidating for the person I’m meeting with to realize that I’m recording the meeting. So I typically just use Voice Memos on my Apple Watch to do the initial recording. After the meeting, I share the audio file over to Wave for the transcript and summary.

Anyhow, I could go on and on. I just really appreciate your app. Great job!!!
Are on point and Organized
Simplifies my work life to where I’m 100% more efficient!

title.label: Did not record all of a call

content.label: I used the app as directed and merged the calls. The app recorded only the first four and a half minutes of a very important 45 minute call. The call was not dropped or interrupted at any time, nor did I even handle the phone during the call as it was on speaker.  I used the app before and it did well for an entire hour long meeting. I will be cancelling my subscription as it is expensive so it should have done better
This app will change your life

This app is limitless and it’s ability to process information is great. I tried three different software AI Claudia, and this the price range was about the same. In fact being unlimited it is really really good option. I’m amazed and the service if not cheaper at the same price because literally can’t find any better deal than this.

I’m just gonna come right out and say it, I am a horrible note taker. The bad part about this is I have a job we’re all I have to do is take notes so that I can fill out reports. I will go to meetings and try to take notes but when I wrote the notes, I didn’t hear what they said, while I was writing a note.
I was on Facebook and found this app. I downloaded the app and I used it, and I was amazed at how well it took notes. I was also amazed at how many things I had missed while in the meeting, oh yeah, did I mention I have ADHD. Wave took down the people names, and somehow they were able to tell who is who when they spoke and they would put down the person name and 98 times out of 100 they were correct. don’t forget to read over what they put down because sometimes they do get the names wrong. If you get the free version they only give you 30 minutes a week. No I’m sorry that’s not right 30 minutes a month trust and believe when I say you’re not gonna be able to take down all your notes and 30 minutes so I said go ahead and buy the application. It is well worth it.
This app is pure magic.

title.label: This app NEVER worked for me. It was a waste of time and money.

content.label: I have never written such a review, but I was unable to get this app to work. It would never produce a transcript. I attempted three times and then canceled my plan .

I have to say that the overused word “amazing” is very appropriate in this case. I can’t believe the speed and accuracy of the meeting summaries, appropriateness of both the categorical breakdowns and analytical conclusions!!

Fantastic!

It soo good and I am loving it. I tried it for 2 of my design sessions as tech lead I am usually engrossed in driving the design session and have a hard time multitasking to capture all notes. And even if we ask team members to take notes junior members are not that involved in the discussion so they don’t take good notes and dont summarize them very well but I was simply fascinated by how Wave did capture all notes from the last two very complex design sessions and it very neatly clearly succinctly gave me a summary with next steps in the way it organized the notes was fantastic I’m just so tempted to become paid user and take the subscription. Great job guys!!
Great app so far, I know there are a lot of improvements they are working on. Looking forward to how it develops from here.

Amazing accuracy and logical organization of audio transcription 

Highly recommend

I really like the ability to summarize conversations. I would like to be able to teach it some terms we use or product names. 

It gets interrupted by phone calls and you aren't allowed to return to a meeting to append. That's a real issue for me. The summary doesn't format well once you try to copy/paste into OneNote. It comes out quite ugly even though the content is great. Maybe an export to OneNote would format it better.

I'd like a MacOS/iOS widget to click it on easily but this is pretty low on the requirements side.

I was hoping to be able to set and forget for several hours and come back to a summary of what had occurred and thoughts I had dictated. There is a severe glitch that causes the voice to text function to fail and fell the silence with what it thinks is spoken words. For example, my silence is filled with repetitive “thank you thank you thank you” because it hears a fan running in the background and makes a guess at what words that might be.
Brand new to this app, so far it seems to work great.

title.label: Best note taking app i’ve used

content.label: This app is super helpful. Saves me lots of time and takes great notes. Support is also A+.

This is a great example of something I didn't know I needed until I used it. Wave doesn't just record conversations -- it digests and summarizes conversations with almost magical intelligence. And then it makes the magic shareable. I'm going to use this (ethically) for so many things -- board meetings, school meetings, team meetings. It does such a good job at taking smart notes, and the thoughtful interface is a pleasure to use.

For years my business partner and I spent countless hours updating each other on what happened in our meetings/calls each day… now we just use Wave to summarize and share all our meetings each day. GAME CHANGER

title.label: The best AI mobile app by a mile

content.label: Brilliant at transcription and summaries. Has been a life saver for doctor visits and meeting notes
Tried it as a test, paid for the monthly subscription and now I cannot figure out how to cancel my monthly subscription.
Great app for live conversations. Would be even better if you were able to upload recordings for transcription.

Such an awesome way to capture insights from meetings without being distracted with taking notes. Allows me to fully engage and trust all of my follow ups will be ready for me! Way better than any human note taker too. And less biased.

Wow. I can’t say enough about this amazing app. It can take a 30 minute meeting and summarize it into a couple pages of bullet points that I can instantly forward to my clients via text message. By the time we leave the meeting, they have a summary of what we discussed as if I had a personal assistant sitting in the meeting taking notes. This is a game changer!
This app looked promising and I was ready to upgrade to paid version of it worked. Unfortunately, a day after my meeting it is still “processing audio”. No notes or summary ever generated.
This app is perfect. You can just turn on the recording tell it what kind of summary you want and go. Cross device syncing is a very nice touch. I will be paying for this app. Well done.

I just started using this app. The quality of notes that it takes and transcribes is fantastic. I used it to record a home building tv show that I was watching. It clearly summarized and organized notes of the entire episode in great detail. I wish it could process the notes in real time so I can also see it at work. It can take awhile after the recording to transcribe the data into notes depending on the length of the recording and your device. For a new app, this is super cool and I can’t wait to see where it goes!
